verdict: New Relic: Choose New Relic when unified observability billed on ingest + users is the job — not Datadog host packs and not ITSM. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Pro path for unlimited full users
bestFor: Teams that want APM + logs + infra in one ingest bill
Orgs that can live with 1–5 Standard full users
Buyers comparing usage-based observability to Datadog hosts
notIdealFor: Teams standardised on Grafana OSS + cheap Cloud Pro usage
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors
Free tiers vs enterprise SSO/audit gates
Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose New Relic when unified observability billed on ingest + users is the job — not Datadog host packs and not ITSM. Compare Datadog for host/module packaging; Grafana Cloud for OSS-aligned usage; PagerDuty for on-call.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
